exposure: Luteal phase support (LPS) with oral progesterone
cohort: A retrospective cohort study of 1199 intrauterine insemination (IUI) cycles using letrozole performed between January 2017 and December 2021.
finding: Luteal support with oral progesterone significantly improved the live birth rate, clinical pregnancy rate, and ongoing pregnancy rate in IUI cycles with letrozole, but did not affect other neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was no significant variance in the mode of delivery between the luteal phase support and control groups.
birth_weight: Not specified, but no significant differences were found between the LPS and control groups.
gest_age: Not specified, but no significant variances were found between the LPS and control groups.
